Who We Are

Advait Infra Realty is a professionally managed real estate, construction, and interior designing solutions company based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. We provide comprehensive property development services across Residential, Commercial, Industrial, and Institutional sectors.

Our company is committed to delivering reliable, transparent, innovative, and customer-focused solutions. From property consultancy and investment guidance to building map approval assistance, architectural planning, construction, renovation, and interior designing, we aim to simplify every stage of property development.

At Advait Infra Realty, we understand that purchasing, developing, or renovating a property is an important financial and personal decision. Therefore, we focus on professional guidance, quality workmanship, transparent communication, and personalized services.

Our Vision

To become a trusted and preferred name in real estate, construction, and interior designing by delivering innovative, sustainable, and high-quality property solutions across Delhi NCR and beyond.

Our Mission

To simplify real estate and construction processes by providing complete solutions under one roof through professional expertise, transparent dealings, quality workmanship, and customer satisfaction.

Payment Terms

Stage-Wise Payments

Payments are linked to the progress of work, as set out in the written agreement.

Agreed in Writing

Scope, specifications, cost estimate and payment schedule are confirmed in writing before work begins.

Clear Records

Each payment is documented, so both sides have a clear record.

Changes Discussed First

Any change in scope that affects cost is discussed and agreed before it is carried out.

General terms. Exact amounts and payment stages are confirmed in the written agreement for each project.

Our Construction Process

Step 4 – Completion

Final inspection support, finishing, and project handover.

Imagine The Interiors

Let's Talk Interiors...

Imagine The Interiors is a professionally managed interior design and space transformation company based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, providing creative, functional and personalized interior solutions since 2009.

Founded by Priyanka Gupta, a postgraduate in Interior Designing from NIFD, Lucknow, the company has successfully delivered over 3,000 interior projects, reflecting its experience in transforming residential and commercial spaces.

We specialize in designing apartments, independent houses, luxury villas, farmhouses, duplex homes, townhouses, corporate offices, cafes, restaurants, showrooms, schools, boutiques and banquet halls.

Our comprehensive services include interior design consultation, architectural layouts, space planning, furniture designing and production, modular kitchens, customized wardrobes, home renovation, civil work, electrical installations, plumbing, flooring, false ceilings, exterior designing and complete turnkey interior solutions.

At Imagine The Interiors, we believe that every space should reflect the personality, lifestyle, preferences and individual requirements of its occupants. Our design philosophy combines creativity, comfort, functionality and elegance to create beautiful and practical living environments.

We follow a systematic approach beginning with client consultation, understanding requirements, layout development, design finalization, material selection, civil work, electrical and plumbing installations, flooring, false ceiling execution, customized furniture installation and final project handover.

Our goal is to establish long-term relationships with clients through personalized attention, innovative design concepts, quality workmanship and professional project execution.

With extensive experience in residential and commercial interior projects, Imagine The Interiors continues to transform ordinary spaces into inspiring environments that enhance comfort, functionality and everyday living.
